The live leg's non-priming probes are the round entries ahead of it: the install read by path and the rig's census, neither of which primes anything. A start refused for the token window is no red to fold: implement stops and says so.

The remove-the-guard controls are implement's one-shot `gate.py control` runs, not entries (validation.md check 4 (6)), each fired with `--timeout 900`, each control's entry the filtered integration entry below (it builds the workspace, so the clone holds every binary its cases spawn; testing.md 2026-11-13); «holds» means each named case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line, and a `timeout` reading is not «holds»: - `fs-trust` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/screen.rs`: the classifier's `trust` arm removed (a trust row reads on   down the arms); case `verify_first_screens_read_trust_then_box_on_the_fake`. With the guard gone the subject   (verify) stamps Run A's first screen as `none`, so the case's `a: trust` fails — measured at implement. - `fs-record` — `src/cmd/verify/typed/runs.rs`: the line storing Run F's reading removed; case   `verify_first_screens_read_trust_then_box_on_the_fake`. With the guard gone Run F's word stamps `null` — measured   at implement. - `rig-gitroot` — `crates/viola-e2e/src/rig/isolate.rs`: the git-root layout step's body removed (nothing written);   case `rig_rehearsal_v_reads_the_trust_record_row_and_no_record_left`. The `git-root` word is read from the disk   (step 6), so with the guard gone the V arm's cwd holds no `.git/HEAD`, the word reads `absent` and the case's   `git-root: written` fails — measured at implement. Each control's id is at most 16 characters.
